OAT-06/S04.title: Scan add and its duplicate prompt through the real scan screens, both contexts: the rows written
OAT-06/S04.detail: Local Playwright spec newspec-c/an2-oat06-s04-scan.spec.ts (2 tests, each a brand-new @roundai.test physician). ai/vision:scanCensusSheet is answered at the Convex socket with the rows the matrix's photos list (Hospital: QA Scan Avery / Brook / Cole plus the existing chart's name and room; Nursing Home: QA Scan Dana / Ellis plus the existing resident's name); the photo itself is a neutral fixture image, so OCR quality (TFA-92580 AC 2/AC 6, B01) is not judged. Rows read from patientActivityEvents with the local admin key. Judged 14/14: R1 Hospital: 3 patient_added (addMethod scan_census, careSetting hospital); exactly one duplicate_prompt_shown and one duplicate_prompt_accepted with the same promptId (scan_census, hospital); no rejected row; still one chart with the fixture name. R2: one shown + one rejected (same promptId, scan_census, hospital), patient_added +1, two charts with the fixture name. R4 Nursing Home: 2 patient_added (scan_census, nursing_home); one scan_census_completed with createdCount 2, linkedCount 1 (selectedCount 3); one shown + one accepted (nursing_home, scan_census); the matched resident is not counted as an add and no copy is made. R5: one shown + one rejected (nursing_home, scan_census), patient_added +1, two residents with the name. U15: no row holds a scanned name, room or unit (19 rows checked). Recorded only (Q5): closing the Hospital scan sheet (X) before confirming shows no prompt and writes nothing; the Hospital prompt has no close or 'decide later' control, so leaving it without a choice (here a reload) writes duplicate_prompt_shown only; Nursing Home 'Decide later' then closing the sheet writes shown only and adds nothing. Recorded: a Hospital scan writes no scan_census_completed row (only Nursing Home does); R5's scan_census_completed has createdCount 1, linkedCount 0. Part left: U13 for the vision call (aiCallLog providerMs > 0 and <= durationMs, model, ai_disclosure provider_ms) needs a live scanCensusSheet call; locally the call is answered in the browser, so no aiCallLog row exists (verified: 0 vision rows for the account), and on dev it is blocked by B01.
